usage_notes: Always use شفاخانه in Afghan Dari context; بیمارستان is Iranian Persian.
Use مرکز صحی or کلینیک; درمانگاه is Iranian Persian.
Standard Afghan official term is راپور; do not use گزارش in official NGO/MoPH context.
Always داکتر; پزشک is Iranian Persian.
Always قابله; ماما in Afghan Dari means maternal uncle!

source_authority: Afghan Civil Service & NGO HR Policy

usage_notes: Use مصرف / مصارف in operational budgets.
Use گدام or دیپو or ذخیره‌گاه.
Always ولادت; زایمان is Iranian Persian.
Spelled سوء تغذی in Afghan health guidelines.
